The Science
What is Carbon Laser Facial?

The laser targets and vaporizes the carbon particles, which absorb dead skin cells, oil, and impurities â leaving skin instantly clearer, brighter, and poreless.

Carbon + Laser Science
How Does It Work?

Liquid Carbon Mask

A thin layer of medical-grade liquid carbon is applied to the skin. The carbon particles penetrate deeply into pores, absorbing dead skin, sebum, and impurities. This creates a 'target' for the laser to act upon precisely.

Q-Switched Nd:YAG Laser

The Q-Switched Nd:YAG laser passes over the carbon-coated skin. The carbon absorbs the laser energy and vaporizes instantly â taking the impurities with it. The laser also stimulates collagen, reduces pigmentation, and refines pores.

The Carbon Facial Process
1

Skin Cleanse

Skin is thoroughly cleansed to remove all makeup, oils, and surface debris. Prepared for optimal carbon penetration.

2

Carbon Mask Application

A thin layer of liquid carbon is applied evenly across the face. Left for 5â10 minutes to penetrate pores deeply and bind to impurities.

3

Laser Passes

The Q-Switched Nd:YAG laser passes over the skin, vaporizing the carbon along with trapped impurities. Mild snapping sensation, like tiny rubber bands.

4

Resume Your Day

Skin is immediately cleaner, brighter, and smoother. Mild redness fades within hours. Pores look smaller, tone more even. Instant Hollywood glow â zero downtime.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Does Carbon Facial hurt?

Very tolerable. Most clients feel a mild snapping sensation during laser passes â like tiny rubber bands. No numbing cream needed. The entire session takes 30 minutes.

How soon will I see results?

Some patients feel improvements immediately after the first session â increased muscle firmness and toning. Visible fat reduction typically appears 2â4 weeks after completing all 4 sessions, with optimal results at 2â3 months as fat cells are naturally eliminated.

Is it safe for Indian skin?

Yes! The Q-Switched Nd:YAG laser is completely safe for Indian skin tones. No risk of hyperpigmentation when performed by qualified dermatologists like Dr. Geetika's team.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Emsculpt NEO pairs excellently with treatments like CoolSculpting, Exilis Elite, and lymphatic drainage. Our experts at ISAAC Luxe can design a comprehensive body contouring plan tailored to your goals.

How often should I get it?

Monthly for maintenance glow. Before events (3â7 days prior) for red-carpet radiance. For acne treatment, bi-weekly series of 4â6 sessions. Completely safe for frequent use.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Carbon Facial pairs beautifully with HydraFacial, AQUAGOLD, and chemical peels. Many clients do Carbon + HydraFacial combo for ultimate Hollywood radiance.
